accessBasis.gate: CreateAccessService for the sales-invoice register, plus LedgerConfigGuard.checkConfig before the form is reachable. Invoice settings are a SettingsScope.company category (admin only).

behaviourReviewed: Amount Details renders in a fixed order: Amount → Additional Charge (only when a labour ledger is mapped) → tax rows → GST basis → company extras → Round Off (only when a round-off ledger is mapped) → Total.
The tax rows are IGST alone, or SGST+CGST — the screen picks, the user does not.
GstBasisField chips are inert with a 'Fixed in Invoice Settings' caption when invoice_defaults.gstModeLocked is set; inert with no caption where the screen has nothing to write to.
The Round Off chip is inert with the same caption under the 'Always on' policy.
The Voucher Type dropdown only renders when the company has more than one sales voucher type name.
Send invoice via WhatsApp only renders when the party has a phone and the invoice is not an imported one; the credit-blocked state disables it with its own reason.
Generate E-Invoice / Generate E-Way Bill switches render conditionally and their failure is reported separately from the invoice save.
Duplicate detection covers both a repeated invoice number and same-amount-same-day, with Proceed to override.
A second save tap is refused with 'Invoice is already being created. Please wait.'

visibilityBlocked.surface: 'Submit for approval · <total>' save mode and the extra-charge approval refusal in invoice_summary_screen.dart
visibilityBlocked.reason: Gated on voucher_approvals, is_customer_visible = false in prod evidence. Not described and not quoted.

deliberatelyOmitted: Settings that are not active in the form were not turned into procedures — the guide states the rule (a field appears only when its switch is on) rather than listing every dark or conditional field.
Batch numbers, godown, cost centre, alternate unit and billing-module discount rules are mentioned only as conditional fields, since each is its own company switch and none is universally present.
No tax advice and no legal thresholds; the e-invoice/e-way switches are described purely as app behaviour and routed to their own guides.
